description: Speech to text: transcribe an audio file at a URL (MP3, WAV, M4A/AAC, OGG/Opus, FLAC, WebM; max 10 MB) with Whisper large v3 turbo. Returns full text, detected language, duration, timestamped segments and WebVTT captions. task=translate gives English text. For podcasts, voice notes, calls and meetings. Price $0.02 USDC per call via x402. Example output: {"text":"Hello and welcome to the show.","language":"en","duration_seconds":4.2,"task":"transcribe","format":"mp3","bytes":67000,"word_count":6,"segments":[{"start":0,"end":4.2,"text":"Hello and welcome to the show."}],"model":"whisper-large-v3-turbo"}

url.description: Public URL of the media file itself

vad.description: true to apply voice activity filtering

name: audio_transcribe
